title: Recognizing Frightened Parts of Your Personality
fullTitle: Soul Snack #8: Recognizing Frightened Parts of Your Personality
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav shares a powerful meditation for developing emotional awareness by tuning into your physical sensations.
This exercise offers a gentle way to build self-awareness , and Gary encourages listeners to journal their experiences for deeper insights.
Let this meditative exercise support your journey toward creating authentic power.
Enjoy this short, impactful exercise, and join Gary in continuing to explore the journey of transforming consciousness and creating authentic power.
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.
